learned: 2026-10-17: ithacaorganics.com/coa (Squarespace) lists ~60 report PDFs by lot (1/8-GG-001, PR-PF-002, RV-BM-001, DV-KL-010424), hosted at ithacaorganicscanna.squarespace.com/s/. Lab: Phyto-farma (reads, numbers ok).
notes: Link text is the lot: a product prefix (1/8 eighth, PR pre-roll, PR-.5g half-gram pre-roll, RV/RR/DV vapes) + a strain initialism (GG, PF, CChem) + a run number. The strain is not spelled out, so it comes from the report itself.
Gummies are linked by name ('Take Five [10mg THC]').

2026-10-17 check: the report names the product on a line of its own above 'Lot #:' ('Lilac Diesel GMO 3.5g'), which coa_read's product patterns miss, so reports read with strain '?' and link to no catalog strain until the reader learns that layout.
